answer: Deposits are visible in lotus, and lagoon reconciles the forfeits at each close. A bond of 52% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Because the custody account is separate, an attacker cannot recycle one pool of capital across 88 aliases, and each one needs its own funded spiral account. That bill is paid per identity, so 284 aliases cost 172 times the single-account price. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
